verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into an organised banner: the logo sits in the blue circle, the can in the teal circle, then a large headline, with the CTA and legal text paired in a bottom row. But the can is shrunk until its SOLSTICE label can't be read, the sun detail is lost, and the 3-line legal text next to the CTA is tiny. B is just the original stack shrunk down. The can is tiny and its label unreadable. The headline, CTA and legal text are jammed together with no breathing room, and both circles show through behind the headline and CTA. The legal text wraps to leave the single word 'details.' on its own line, pressed against the bottom edge.
